title: Skill output capture
description: A captured skill response for a case. The prose answer is the deliverable; the trace fields let the deterministic layer check activation/sufficiency without an LLM.

module_trace.description: Modules the skill treated as ACTIVE for this case (self-declared). Used by deterministic P13/P14 checks.

inactive_declared.description: Modules explicitly judged inactive/irrelevant for this case.

references_cited.description: reference files the answer relied on; checked against the real references/ directory for dangling refs.

self_audit.description: Optional self-check block; required only when mode demands it.
